newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Hellaby announces share repurchase offer.
newsitem.headline: Hellaby announces share repurchase offer.

text.p: Investment company Hellaby Holdings Ltd announced on Friday it would make a pro-rata share repurchase offer at a probable one-for-five ratio.
The offer will be made on November 6.
That ratio is subject to final confirmation by the board and to the share price on the record date.
Shareholders will have the option of offering to sell to the company more than the ratio of 1:5 though acceptance of further shares is discretionary on the part of the company.
The record date will be November 1.
The offer applies to 11,863,038 shares, one fifth of the total shares on issue.

A number of conditions will attach to the offer, including obtaining acceptances with a value of at least $15 million for the purposes of the income tax rules dealing with dividends and completion or reregistration of the company.
The amount to be offered per share will be struck at or shortly after the record date.

As has previously been notified, the source of the funds for the repurchase is capital returned from the company's investments in the United States. The offer closes on December 6 and payment will be made 10 days later.
